about.title: Exeter Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Exeter is a small town of roughly 10,548 people, and when a family here loses someone, the loss is felt well beyond one household. Public records for 2024 list a single injury collision in Exeter and no traffic deaths, which says something important: in a community this size, a death is never a statistic. It is a neighbor, a coworker, a person others counted on. Wrongful death claims are not limited to crashes, either. A fall on poorly maintained property, a medical error, a workplace incident, or a defective product can each give rise to a civil claim under California law. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Tulare County families with an independent attorney who can review what happened, explain who is legally allowed to bring the claim, and take the case on contingency. Whether the loss occurred near Kaweah Street, Palm Avenue, Visalia Road, or Firebaugh, or somewhere far from Exeter altogether, you should not have to untangle the legal side while you are grieving.

whyChoose.title: Why Exeter Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can tell you quickly whether you or another family member is the right person to bring the claim.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: The general filing deadline is two years from the date of death, and it is shorter when a public agency is involved. Connecting with an attorney sooner protects those dates while you focus on your family.

items.title: Recovery that reflects real losses
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Network attorneys work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Exeter had no traffic deaths in 2024. Can a wrongful death claim still arise here?
items.answer: Yes. Wrongful death claims cover far more than roadway crashes, including medical negligence, unsafe property, workplace incidents, and defective products. And a fatal crash involving an Exeter resident may have happened on a highway or in another city entirely. The claim follows the circumstances of the death, not the city limits.

items.question: If there is a criminal case, do we have to wait for it to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that is entirely separate from any criminal prosecution. The two can move forward at the same time, and a civil claim does not depend on a conviction. An attorney can explain how one might affect the other in your situation.

items.question: What does it cost to be connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning they are paid only if there is a recovery for your family.
